WITH rec AS (
  SELECT cr.id, cr.campaign_id, c.company_id, cr.lead_id, cr.sent_at,
         right(regexp_replace(cr.phone, '\D', '', 'g'), 8) AS tail
  FROM public.campaign_recipients cr JOIN public.campaigns c ON c.id = cr.campaign_id
  WHERE cr.status = 'sent' AND cr.sent_at IS NOT NULL
),
conv AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT x.id, x.company_id, x.tail FROM (
    SELECT w.id, w.company_id, right(regexp_replace(split_part(w.remote_jid, '@', 1), '\D', '', 'g'), 8) AS tail
    FROM public.wapi_conversations w WHERE w.remote_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us'
      AND w.company_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT company_id FROM rec)
  ) x WHERE length(x.tail) = 8
),
lds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT x.id, x.company_id, x.tail FROM (
    SELECT l.id, l.company_id, right(regexp_replace(coalesce(l.whatsapp, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 8) AS tail
    FROM public.campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT company_id FROM rec)
  ) x WHERE length(x.tail) = 8
),
replied AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM rec r JOIN conv cv ON cv.tail = r.tail AND cv.company_id = r.company_id
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.wapi_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = cv.id AND m.from_me = false
    AND m.timestamp > r.sent_at AND m.timestamp < r.sent_at + interval '3 days')
),
rec_leads AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.company_id, (r.sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS sent_day, r.lead_id FROM rec r WHERE r.lead_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT r.id, r.company_id, (r.sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date, ld.id FROM rec r JOIN lds ld ON ld.tail = r.tail AND ld.company_id = r.company_id
),
closed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rl.id FROM rec_leads rl JOIN public.company_events e ON e.lead_id = rl.lead_id
  WHERE e.company_id = rl.company_id AND e.status <> 'cancelado'
    AND coalesce(e.data_fechamento_venda, (e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) >= rl.sent_day
    AND coalesce(e.data_fechamento_venda, (e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) <= rl.sent_day + 45
)
SELECT co.name AS empresa, c.name AS campanha, min(r.sent_at)::date AS primeiro_envio, count(*) AS enviados,
       count(rp.id) AS responderam, round(100.0 * count(rp.id) / count(*)) AS pct_resp, count(cl.id) AS fecharam
FROM rec r JOIN public.campaigns c ON c.id = r.campaign_id JOIN public.companies co ON co.id = r.company_id
LEFT JOIN replied rp ON rp.id = r.id LEFT JOIN closed cl ON cl.id = r.id
GROUP BY co.name, c.name ORDER BY 3 DESC
